summary: Implemented split_amount in ledger/split.py per docs/CONVENTIONS.md (integer cents, conservation, leftover cents to earliest parties, refunds split by absolute value then negated, ValueError for non-positive parties) and added tests covering these rules.
assumptions: 'Evenly' follows docs/CONVENTIONS.md: when not exactly divisible, the leftover cents go one each to the earliest parties, e.g. split_amount(1000, 3) == [334, 333, 333].
A total of 0 is valid and yields zeros; only parties <= 0 raises ValueError.
Non-integer inputs are not validated beyond the type hints.
